title: Converto
shortDescription: Converto is a lightweight desktop application that converts PDF and DOCX documents into high-quality PNG and JPEG images. Built for speed, simplicity, and offline use, it makes document-to-image conversion effortless.
fullDescription: Converto is a professional desktop application designed to convert PDF and DOCX documents into high-quality PNG and JPEG images with ease. Whether converting a single file or processing multiple documents in batches, Converto delivers fast, reliable, and accurate results while working entirely offline.
